description_en: Queries the details of a specified parser, including basic information, data parsing script, running status, and associated data sources
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定解析器的详细信息，包括解析器基本信息、解析脚本、运行状态和关联的数据源等
name: GetParser

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The parser ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429046.html operation to query the list of parsers and obtain the ParserId
parameters.help_zh: 解析器ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429046.html，查询解析器列表，获取**ParserId**
parameters.name: parser_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_zh: 返回的解析器详细信息

DataSourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source associated with the parser

Script.description_en: The published script of the parser
Script.example: var data = payload("json"); var h = data.items.Humidity.value; var t = data.items.Temperature.value; writeTsdb(1000,timestamp(),"temperature", t , {"deviceName":deviceName()}); writeTsdb(1000,timestamp(),"humidity", h , {"deviceName":deviceName()});

ScriptDraft.description_en: The draft of the parser script
ScriptDraft.example: var data = payload("json"); var h = data.items.Humidity.value; var t = data.items.Temperature.value; writeTsdb(1000,timestamp(),"temperature", t , {"deviceName":deviceName()}); writeTsdb(1000,timestamp(),"humidity", h , {"deviceName":deviceName()});

Status.description_en:
The running status of the parser. Valid values:

RUNNING: Running.
STOP: Stopped.
ABNORMAL: Abnormal
Status.description_zh:
解析器运行状态。可取值：

RUNNING：运行中。
STOP：已停止。
ABNORMAL：存在异常

UtcCreated.description_en: The time when the parser was created, in UTC. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` format

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the parser was last updated, in UTC. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` format

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
